findings.passage: I am skeptical that our information won’t be used at the federal level in a way that won’t harm Oregonians.
findings.note: Quoted by OPB from her remarks in the House Judiciary Committee hearing on HB 4145 (Measure 114 implementation), where she raised concern about sending fingerprints to the FBI for gun-buyer background checks and said she is a gun owner.

findings.passage: During the break, it was brought to my attention that in the FBI regulation, that when you submit your information for background checks, fingerprinting, the information is destroyed after 24 hours. I hope we all scrutinize to make sure that it ends up saving lives and all the boxes are checked and it is not put together at the last minute with a lot of loopholes and unintended consequences.
findings.note: Quoted by OPB from her committee remarks explaining why she changed her vote on an HB 4145 amendment from no to yes after a recess.

findings.passage: I have a great deal of respect for Chair Kropf, yet his management of events did create confusion, suspicion, and distrust in the Democratic process
findings.note: Quoted by OPB from her statement about how the HB 4145 committee vote was handled; it concerns the process of the gun bill vote, not the content of the policy.
